summary.text: Nri had no army. Allegiance to the Eze Nri came by ritual oath, not force; violence was held an abomination that polluted the earth, and his punishment was to cut a town off from the Nri order.

arms.text: Ritual authority spread by travelling agents (mbùríchi); the Eze Nri could excommunicate a town.

reviewNotes: Arms levels (1 some, 2 a real strength, 3 famous for it) are the compiler’s judgement from the sources, for the Versus page’s guess; please check them.
